description: Speed and caching of one of the customer's own WordPress websites: get (OPcache numbers and recommended settings, Redis object cache state, hit rate, evictions, biggest key groups, cache guard, health flags), opcache_profile (apply the recommended OPcache settings), opcache_reset, redis_enable, redis_disable, redis_flush, tuning_on and tuning_off (the cache guard that keeps flood-prone groups such as WooCommerce attribute relationships out of Redis). Everything except get and opcache_reset needs a confirm. opcache_reset empties the shared OPcache of the whole PHP pool the site runs in (once every 30 seconds).

action.description: get (default), opcache_profile, opcache_reset, redis_enable, redis_disable, redis_flush, tuning_on or tuning_off.

domain.description: Primary domain of the website, instead of serviceId.

groups.description: tuning_on: extra cache groups to keep out of Redis (lowercase letters, digits, _ and -).

profile.description: opcache_profile: standard or large (default: large for WooCommerce).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id of the website.

name: oma_wp_cache
title: WordPress speed and caching
